sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Broadcast - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, friend. I've been thinking about something. It's starting to seem to me that I don't really understand anything in life. Come, sit down... People are saying there's a live broadcast going somewhere in the city. They say that someone is performing surgeries and filming it on their camera. I'd understand if it was an actually good willed doctor helping people. I would even understand if there was an organ trade, although that in itself is disgusting. But tell me, why stream this? Is this a kink for some perverted oligarchs? I honestly don't have an answer. But I do know that this broadcast must be shut down. Can you put a jammer near them?"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate the hidden recording studio on Lighthouse
- Place a Signal Jammer inside the studio
Note: The "Place" objective will appear after the "Locate" objective is completed.

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- 6,700 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.03
- 650 Euros
  - 683 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 748 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Can of thermite
- 1× Pack of nails
"Corpse bags and crates with organs? Yikes... I'm glad we stopped this. Although we didn't get to the bottom of this. I'll investigate who might have been the culprit and let you know later."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Find in raid | Notes |
| Operating room key | 1 | Required | N/A | Used to open the recording studio |
| Signal Jammer | 1 | Required | N/A | Can be purchased from Mechanic LL1. |
In this quest you have to find the hidden recording studio on Lighthouse and place a Signal Jammer there. An Operating room key is needed to enter it. The studio can be found on the first floor of office building #1, which is located at the water treatment plant area in the north.
